components.title: BPE merge step
components.tagline: One training step: count pairs, pick the best, merge it everywhere.

components.title: BPE encode
components.tagline: Replay the learned merges by priority to tokenize a word.

components.title: Linear layer
components.tagline: Affine map over the last axis; batch dimensions come along for free.

components.title: Softmax
components.tagline: Normalise to a distribution along one axis, without overflowing.

components.title: Layer norm
components.tagline: Centre and rescale each token vector, then apply gain and bias.

components.title: RMSNorm
components.tagline: Layer norm without the mean subtraction — what modern LMs use.

components.title: SwiGLU feed-forward
components.tagline: A gated MLP: SiLU on one branch, elementwise product, project back.

components.title: Scaled dot-product attention
components.tagline: The core operation: scores, scale, mask, softmax, combine.

components.title: Causal mask
components.tagline: Boolean mask that also works when the keys carry a KV cache.

components.title: Multi-head attention
components.tagline: Project, split into heads with einops, attend, merge, project.

components.title: Grouped-query attention
components.tagline: Fewer KV heads than query heads — the KV-cache saver.

components.title: Rotary embeddings (RoPE)
components.tagline: Rotate feature pairs by an angle proportional to position.

components.title: Pre-norm transformer block
components.tagline: Wire norms, attention, MLP and residuals in the right order.

components.title: Cross-entropy loss
components.tagline: Straight from logits, with the log-sum-exp trick.

components.title: Cross-entropy backward
components.tagline: The gradient every interview asks for: softmax minus one-hot.

components.title: AdamW step
components.tagline: Bias-corrected moments plus decoupled weight decay.

components.title: Gradient clipping
components.tagline: Rescale a whole parameter list by its global L2 norm.

components.title: Cosine LR schedule
components.tagline: Linear warmup, cosine decay, then a constant floor.

components.title: KV-cache decode step
components.tagline: Append one token to the cache and attend — no mask needed.

components.title: Top-p (nucleus) filtering
components.tagline: Keep the smallest set of tokens covering probability p.
